## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix`)
- [ ] New feature (`feat`)
- [ ] Refactor (`refactor`)
- [ ] Tests (`test`)
- [ ] Docs (`docs`)
- [ ] Chore (`chore`)

## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run check` is clean (TypeScript, no errors)
- [ ] `bun run format:check` passes (dprint)
- [ ] `bun run lint` passes (oxlint, no errors)
- [ ] `bun test` passes
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits (`type(scope): summary`), one concern each
- [ ] Added or updated tests for the change
- [ ] The machine-readable CLI contract (`dss commands run`, `dss agent contract`) is unchanged — or the change is intentional and versioned
